actions.action: Check sun-facing leaves for bleached or crispy patches
Finger-test soil 2 inches deep and lift pot to check weight
If soil is hydrophobic, soak pot in sink or bucket for 20-30 minutes and drain
If no drainage hole, repot into draining pot or use nursery pot inside cover
Move plant to bright indirect light or partial shade, then gradually reintroduce sun
Check soil every 2-3 days and water when top inch is dry
